_comment: Shot list for episode 12, the second of six on sight lost and not given back. 15 new paintings plus the title and close backgrounds (prompts below, generated in this order in Gemini; Brian downloads them in order into images/ep12_the_voice_and_the_hands/). Shared stills: the scroll, Brian's picture, Henry's study (episode 7), the tent at evening (episode 11), the touch scene from the site (site_batch1/01_isaac), two site pictures, the episode map (maps/ep12.png). Rebekah is seen only from behind, listening; Esau at the door is a silhouette; nobody's face is shown. The imagined scenes are the two arrivals at the tent door. Title and close cards get their lettering from make_cards.py (title_card.jpg, close_card.jpg).
style: Painterly oil-sketch look, visible brushwork, warm natural light, the land and buildings of ancient Israel and its neighbours unless the prompt says otherwise. No faces shown close up: people are seen from behind or at a distance. No text or lettering anywhere. Calm and hopeful, never frightening or graphic. 16:9.
